title: Prohibited Buzzword: 'revolutionary'
body: Avoid sensational tech/marketing buzzwords. Do not use 'revolutionary'. Prefer 'scientifically formulated' or 'innovative'.

title: Prohibited Claim Word: 'miracle'
body: Medical or supernatural promise words like 'miracle' violate brand guidelines and regulatory standards. Use 'restorative' or 'effective'.

title: Prohibited Absolute: 'guaranteed'
body: Do not promise absolute medical or physical guarantees. Use 'designed to support' or 'formulated to promote'.

title: Prohibited Quality Term: 'cheap'
body: Do not refer to pricing as 'cheap'. Always describe accessibility as 'affordable' or 'cost-effective'.
